text:
Football Italia Live Blog
Join us for all the build-up and action as it happens from the Champions League, as Napoli visit Francesco Farioli’s FC Porto and Como are away to RC Lens.
They both kick off at 20.00 GMT (21.00 CET).
The Partenopei finally got their first European points with a 4-3 victory over Bodo/Glimt, but are coming off the weekend’s 2-0 Serie A loss to Juventus.
Cesc Fabregas and Como won both home games in the Champions League, but lost away to Feyenoord, so the pressure is on against Florian Thauvin’s Lens.
- All
- Favourites 0
Max Allegri admits Napoli have ‘limitations’ after a 4-1 defeat to FC Porto, as their Champions League campaign hangs by a thread. ‘These are the mistakes that cost you matches.’
Cesc Fabregas admits the 9-1 win in Lens was ‘a wonderful night for Como, but we need to keep our feet on the ground’ as Champions League ambition starts to genuinely build.
Como made history with an astonishing 9-1 victory away to RC Lens in the Champions League, including a Tasos Douvikas hat-trick and 18-year-old Matteo Papaccioli scoring on his debut.
He scores on his debut! It’s not offside! The 18-year-old runs onto the pass from Liberali, then goes to hug Fabregas!
Napoli had got back on track with Scott McTominay, but crumbled in a 4-1 defeat to Francesco Farioli’s Porto with some terrible defending on set plays and late Rafa Marin red card.
That’s very tight….
Papaccioli had scored on his debut.
Sends Meret the wrong way, and Napoli’s goal difference takes another hit.
Remember, this Porto side is top of the domestic league, but lost all three previous Champions League games.
Well that felt inevitable.
Samu on the counter-attack, brought down with zero attempt to play the ball from Rafa Marin.
Nearly 1-9… Cross for Yan Couto at the back post, he can’t keep his volley down!
Porto lead once again against Napoli 👏
Gabriel Veiga with a smooth finish 🎯
📺 Stream now on TNT Sports & HBO Max https://t.co/fRCRh6tXYB https://t.co/g6eg4MXtQ8
— Football on TNT Sports (@footballontnt) November 4, 2026
Gilmour has a pop from distance, but that’s not going to trouble Porto.
Lucca on for Politano, a bit late.
Napoli refusing to learn any lessons and allowing another completely free header on a corner, this time the former Spezia and Arsenal defender.
Napoli finally make changes.
Giovane and Lang on, Anguissa and Vergara off.
Inbeom Hwang and Fofana on, Gabriel Veiga and Pepe off.
Porto let Napoli off the hook with a similar counter-attack, Samu gets greedy and goes for goal himself, but it’s too weak to beat Meret!
Smolcic on, Kempf off
Angled drive into the far bottom corner after dribbling into the box.
Napoli have not made a change yet, and they look tired.
Porto take advantage, as Gabriel Veiga runs onto the Santiago Gimenez pass, is one on one with Meret and deposits into the net.
It’s turning into a siege here, Gabriel Veiga strike from the edge of the box hits the bar!
Santiago Gimenez into a promising situation, but scuffs the finish into the arms of Meret.
Pepe scuffs the half-volley from a promising position and sends it wide.
Santiago Gimenez and Zaidu Sanusi on, Borja Sainz and Martim Fernandes off.
That is a lovely goal, in fairness.
Corner routine finds Aguilar unmarked to hit a fine volley into the far bottom corner from 12 yards.
Mad scramble on a set play, Rafa Marin makes the crucial block from five yards with his chest on Alberto Costa!
Oh boy.
Liberali sprints down the right and beats the goalkeeper with an angled drive.
This is getting ugly now.
Douvikas off, debut for Matteo Papaccioli.
digest_he: משחקי ליגת האלופות סיפקו תוצאות דרמטיות, בראשן ניצחון חוץ היסטורי ומוחץ של קומו בתוצאה 9 ל-1 על RC לנס, שכלל שלושער של טסוס דופיקאס ושער בכורה לשחקן בן ה-18 מתאו פאפאצ'ולי תחת הדרכתו של ססק פברגאס. במקביל, נאפולי רשמה משחק חלש והובסה בתוצאה 4 ל-1 בחוץ מול פורטו של המאמן פרנצ'סקו פאריולי. האיטלקים התקשו מאוד במצבים נייחים וסבלו מטעויות הגנתיות קשות שנוצלו היטב על ידי גבריאל וייגה וחבריו לפורטו, ובנוסף ספגו כרטיס אדום למאורו מארין לקראת סיום ההתמודדות שהותיר אותם בעשרה שחקנים.
